items.title: Canada to Cease Compelling U.S. Streamers to Help Finance Domestic Broadcasting
items.summary: Canada will abandon efforts to compel foreign streamers to make mandatory financial contributions to the domestic entertainment industry, according to a court filing.

items.title: Scoop: People Incorporated explores sale of The Daily Beast again
items.summary: People Incorporated, formerly known as IAC, is exploring a possible sale of The Daily Beast as it looks to focus its portfolio around People Inc. and MGM, sources told Axios.

items.title: Warner Bros. Stock Hits Lowest Price Since Paramount Deal: Merger Odds Around 50%
items.summary: Warner Bros. Discovery  stock Monday hit its lowest point since the company’s merger with  Paramount Skydance  was reached in February as Wall Street appears to be putting little more than a 50% chance that the deal will get done.  Warner Bros. stock dropped 1.8% Monday to $25.28, ending about 18% below the $31-a-share cash offer from Paramount, whose stock also declined Monday.  Warner Bros. stock had been trading around $27 in June.
